The Hon'Ble Smt.Justice Tirumala Devi Eada
 Criminal Petition No.11187 of 2025
Order:

-
1. This Criminal Petition is filed under Section 528 of Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita (BNSS),
2023 seeking the Court to suspend the order dated 25.08.2025 passed in Crl.M.P.No.882 of 2025 in SC.POCSO.No.433 of 2022, on the file of the Court of Fast Track Special Judge for Trial and Disposal of Rape and POCSO Act cases, Ranga Reddy District at L.B.Nagar.

entities.text: Court of Fast Track Special Judge for Trial and Disposal of Rape and POCSO Act cases, Ranga Reddy District
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
2. Heard Sri Alluri Divakar Reddy, learned counsel for the petitioner/accused as well as Sri Jitender Rao Veeramalla, the learned Additional Public Prosecutor appearing for the respondent No.1- State.
3.

The learned petitioner's counsel submitted that the petitioner herein filed a petition vide Crl.M.P.No.882 of 2025 before the Trial Court seeking to recall and reopen the evidence of PWs 5 &
7 and the same was erroneously dismissed by the Trial Court.

He submitted that the Trial Court ought to have given them a chance to further cross-examine the witnesses to prove their defense and therefore prayed to set-aside the orders passed by the Trial Court.
4. The learned Additional Public Prosecutor has submitted that the Trial Court has passed a reasoned order and there is no need to interfere with the same.
5. Perused the record.
The record discloses that PWs 5 & 7 were already cross-examined at length.
The copy of the petition filed by the petitioner before the Trial Court reveals no specific contentions of the counsel as to on which point he has to further cross-examine the said witnesses.
The petitioner/accused is facing allegations under Section 376(2)(n) of IPC and Section 5 read with 6 of POCSO Act, 2012.
The matter is sensitive in nature and it pertains to the year 2022.
However, PWs 5 & 7 were cross- examined on earlier occasion and there are no new facts to be elicited from them for further cross-examination.
Therefore the Trial Court has rightly dismissed the petition filed by the petitioner.
There is no infirmity in the order passed by the Trial Court and the present application is devoid of merits and is liable to be dismissed.
6. In the result, the Criminal Petition is dismissed.
7. Miscellaneous petitions pending, if any, shall stand closed.
_ __ JUSTICE TIRUMALA DEVI EADA Dt.04.11.2025 ysk
